passages.text: “Shout for joy, O barren woman, who bears no children; break forth in song and cry aloud, you who have never travailed; because more are the children of the desolate woman than of her who has a husband,” says the LORD.
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks.
He addresses a woman who cannot have children.
She is barren.
She has never given birth.
The LORD commands her to shout for joy.
He tells her to break forth in song.
He tells her to cry aloud.
She has never experienced labor pains.
She has never travailed.
The LORD explains the reason for her joy.
The desolate woman will have more children.
She will have more children than the married woman.
The LORD declares this promise.
passages.original: רָנִּ֥י עֲקָרָ֖ה לֹ֣א יָלָ֑דָה פִּצְחִ֨י רִנָּ֤ה וְצַהֲלִי֙ לֹא־ חָ֔לָה כִּֽי־ רַבִּ֧ים בְּֽנֵי־ שׁוֹמֵמָ֛ה מִבְּנֵ֥י בְעוּלָ֖ה אָמַ֥ר יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: “Enlarge the site of your tent, stretch out the curtains of your dwellings, do not hold back. Lengthen your ropes and drive your stakes in deep.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to His people.
God promises blessing and growth.
God commands you to make room for increase.
Enlarge the place where you live.
Stretch out the curtains of your dwellings.
Do not hold back.
Lengthen your ropes.
Make your stakes strong and secure.
passages.original: הַרְחִ֣יבִי׀ מְק֣וֹם אָהֳלֵ֗ךְ וִירִיע֧וֹת מִשְׁכְּנוֹתַ֛יִךְ יַטּ֖וּ אַל־ תַּחְשֹׂ֑כִי הַאֲרִ֙יכִי֙ מֵֽיתָרַ֔יִךְ וִיתֵדֹתַ֖יִךְ חַזֵּֽקִי׃

passages.text: For you will spread out to the right and left; your descendants will dispossess the nations and inhabit the desolate cities.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to His people.
God promises growth and blessing.
You will spread out to the right.
You will spread out to the left.
Your descendants will take possession of other nations.
Your descendants will live in cities that were once empty.
passages.original: כִּי־ יָמִ֥ין וּשְׂמֹ֖אול תִּפְרֹ֑צִי וְזַרְעֵךְ֙ גּוֹיִ֣ם יִירָ֔שׁ וְעָרִ֥ים נְשַׁמּ֖וֹת יוֹשִֽׁיבוּ׃

passages.text: Do not be afraid, for you will not be put to shame; do not be intimidated, for you will not be humiliated. For you will forget the shame of your youth and will remember no more the reproach of your widowhood.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to His people.
God tells them not to be afraid.
You will not be put to shame.
Do not feel intimidated.
You will not be humiliated.
You will forget the shame you had when you were young.
You will not remember the disgrace you felt as a widow.
God promises to remove your shame and your sorrow.
passages.original: אַל־ תִּֽירְאִי֙ כִּי־ לֹ֣א תֵב֔וֹשִׁי וְאַל־ תִּכָּלְמִ֖י כִּ֣י לֹ֣א תַחְפִּ֑ירִי כִּ֣י בֹ֤שֶׁת עֲלוּמַ֙יִךְ֙ תִּשְׁכָּ֔חִי וְחֶרְפַּ֥ת אַלְמְנוּתַ֖יִךְ לֹ֥א תִזְכְּרִי־ עֽוֹד׃

passages.text: For your husband is your Maker— the LORD of Hosts is His name— the Holy One of Israel is your Redeemer; He is called the God of all the earth.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is your Maker.
He is your husband.
His name is the LORD of Hosts.
He is the Holy One of Israel.
He is your Redeemer.
People call Him the God of all the earth.
passages.original: כִּ֤י בֹעֲלַ֙יִךְ֙ עֹשַׂ֔יִךְ יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת שְׁמ֑וֹ וְגֹֽאֲלֵךְ֙ קְד֣וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֱלֹהֵ֥י כָל־ הָאָ֖רֶץ יִקָּרֵֽא׃

passages.text: For the LORD has called you back, like a wife deserted and wounded in spirit, like the rejected wife of one’s youth,” says your God.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is your God.
The LORD has called you back.
You were like a wife who was left alone.
You were like a woman who was sad in her spirit.
You were like a wife from youth who was rejected.
Your God says this.
passages.original: כִּֽי־ כְאִשָּׁ֧ה עֲזוּבָ֛ה וַעֲצ֥וּבַת ר֖וּחַ קְרָאָ֣ךְ יְהוָ֑ה וְאֵ֧שֶׁת נְעוּרִ֛ים כִּ֥י תִמָּאֵ֖ס אָמַ֥ר אֱלֹהָֽיִךְ׃

passages.text: “For a brief moment I forsook you, but with great compassion I will bring you back.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to His people Israel.
God says, “I left you for a short time.
I turned away from you for only a moment.
But I have great compassion for you.
I will gather you to Myself again with much mercy.”
passages.original: בְּרֶ֥גַע קָטֹ֖ן עֲזַבְתִּ֑יךְ וּבְרַחֲמִ֥ים גְּדֹלִ֖ים אֲקַבְּצֵֽךְ׃

passages.text: In a surge of anger I hid My face from you for a moment, but with everlasting kindness I will have compassion on you,” says the LORD your Redeemer.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is your Redeemer.
The LORD speaks to you.
The LORD became very angry for a short time.
The LORD turned away from you for a moment.
The LORD did not look at you during that time.
The LORD now shows you everlasting kindness.
The LORD has compassion on you forever.
passages.original: בְּשֶׁ֣צֶף קֶ֗צֶף הִסְתַּ֨רְתִּי פָנַ֥י רֶ֙גַע֙ מִמֵּ֔ךְ וּבְחֶ֥סֶד עוֹלָ֖ם רִֽחַמְתִּ֑יךְ אָמַ֥ר גֹּאֲלֵ֖ךְ יְהוָֽה׃ס

passages.text: “For to Me this is like the days of Noah, when I swore that the waters of Noah would never again cover the earth. So I have sworn that I will not be angry with you or rebuke you.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is speaking.
The LORD is your Redeemer.
The LORD remembers the days of Noah.
In Noah’s days, God made a promise.
God swore that the waters of Noah would never again cover the earth.
Now, God makes a new promise to you.
God swears that He will not be angry with you.
God swears that He will not rebuke you.
passages.original: כִּי־ מֵ֥י נֹ֙חַ֙ זֹ֣את לִ֔י אֲשֶׁ֣ר נִשְׁבַּ֗עְתִּי מֵעֲבֹ֥ר מֵי־ נֹ֛חַ ע֖וֹד עַל־ הָאָ֑רֶץ כֵּ֥ן נִשְׁבַּ֛עְתִּי מִקְּצֹ֥ף עָלַ֖יִךְ וּמִגְּעָר־ בָּֽךְ׃

passages.text: Though the mountains may be removed and the hills may be shaken, My loving devotion will not depart from you, and My covenant of peace will not be broken,” says the LORD, who has compassion on you.
passages.sermon:
The LORD has compassion on you.
The LORD speaks to you.
Mountains may be removed.
Hills may be shaken.
My loving devotion will not leave you.
My covenant of peace will not be broken.
passages.original: כִּ֤י הֶֽהָרִים֙ יָמ֔וּשׁוּ וְהַגְּבָע֖וֹת תְּמוּטֶ֑נָה וְחַסְדִּ֞י מֵאִתֵּ֣ךְ לֹֽא־ יָמ֗וּשׁ וּבְרִ֤ית שְׁלוֹמִי֙ לֹ֣א תָמ֔וּט אָמַ֥ר מְרַחֲמֵ֖ךְ יְהוָֽה׃ס

passages.text: “O afflicted city, lashed by storms, without solace, surely I will set your stones in antimony and lay your foundations with sapphires.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to a city that suffers.
This city is afflicted.
Storms have struck this city.
No one has comforted this city.
God promises to act.
God will set the city's stones in antimony.
God will lay the city's foundations with sapphires.
passages.original: עֲנִיָּ֥ה סֹעֲרָ֖ה לֹ֣א נֻחָ֑מָה הִנֵּ֨ה אָנֹכִ֜י מַרְבִּ֤יץ בַּפּוּךְ֙ אֲבָנַ֔יִךְ וִיסַדְתִּ֖יךְ בַּסַּפִּירִֽים׃

passages.text: I will make your pinnacles of rubies, your gates of sparkling jewels, and all your walls of precious stones.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to His people.
God promises to bless them.
God says, “I will make your highest points from rubies.
I will make your gates from shining jewels.
I will make all your walls from precious stones.”
passages.original: וְשַׂמְתִּ֤י כַּֽדְכֹד֙ שִׁמְשֹׁתַ֔יִךְ וּשְׁעָרַ֖יִךְ לְאַבְנֵ֣י אֶקְדָּ֑ח וְכָל־ גְּבוּלֵ֖ךְ לְאַבְנֵי־ חֵֽפֶץ׃

passages.text: Then all your sons will be taught by the LORD, and great will be their prosperity.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to a city that suffers.
This city has people who are troubled.
God promises to help them.
All your children will learn from the LORD.
The LORD will teach your children.
Your children will have great peace.
Your children will have much well-being.
passages.original: וְכָל־ בָּנַ֖יִךְ לִמּוּדֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְרַ֖ב שְׁל֥וֹם בָּנָֽיִךְ׃

passages.text: In righteousness you will be established, far from oppression, for you will have no fear. Terror will be far removed, for it will not come near you.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to His people.
God promises to establish you in righteousness.
You will be far from oppression.
You will not fear.
Terror will stay far away from you.
Terror will not come near you.
passages.original: בִּצְדָקָ֖ה תִּכּוֹנָ֑נִי רַחֲקִ֤י מֵעֹ֙שֶׁק֙ כִּֽי־ לֹ֣א תִירָ֔אִי וּמִ֨מְּחִתָּ֔ה כִּ֥י לֹֽא־ תִקְרַ֖ב אֵלָֽיִךְ׃

passages.text: If anyone attacks you, it is not from Me; whoever assails you will fall before you.
passages.sermon: God speaks to His people.\r\nGod says, “If anyone attacks you, I did not send them.\r\nAnyone who fights against you will fall before you.”
passages.original: הֵ֣ן גּ֥וֹר יָג֛וּר אֶ֖פֶס מֵֽאוֹתִ֑י מִי־ גָ֥ר אִתָּ֖ךְ עָלַ֥יִךְ יִפּֽוֹל׃

passages.text: Behold, I have created the craftsman who fans the coals into flame and forges a weapon fit for its task; and I have created the destroyer to wreak havoc.
passages.sermon:
God speaks in this passage.
God says, “I created the craftsman.
The craftsman blows on the coals to make a fire.
The craftsman shapes tools and weapons for his work.
I also created the destroyer.
The destroyer brings ruin and destruction.”
passages.original: הֵן אָֽנֹכִי֙ בָּרָ֣אתִי חָרָ֔שׁ נֹפֵ֙חַ֙ בְּאֵ֣שׁ פֶּחָ֔ם וּמוֹצִ֥יא כְלִ֖י לְמַעֲשֵׂ֑הוּ וְאָנֹכִ֛י בָּרָ֥אתִי מַשְׁחִ֖ית לְחַבֵּֽל׃

passages.text: No weapon formed against you shall prosper, and you will refute every tongue that accuses you. This is the heritage of the servants of the LORD, and their vindication is from Me,” declares the LORD.
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks to His servants.
No weapon that anyone forms against you will succeed.
You will prove every tongue wrong that rises against you in judgment.
This is the inheritance of the LORD’s servants.
I, the LORD, give them their righteousness.
passages.original: כָּל־ כְּלִ֞י יוּצַ֤ר עָלַ֙יִךְ֙ לֹ֣א יִצְלָ֔ח וְכָל־ לָשׁ֛וֹן תָּֽקוּם־ אִתָּ֥ךְ לַמִּשְׁפָּ֖ט תַּרְשִׁ֑יעִי זֹ֡את נַחֲלַת֩ עַבְדֵ֨י יְהוָ֧ה וְצִדְקָתָ֛ם מֵאִתִּ֖י נְאֻם־ יְהוָֽה׃ס
